basic_details.job_title: GMCH Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: GMCH Recruitment 2026: the Department of Pediatrics, GMCH-32, Chandigarh, is engaging a Data Entry Operator on a three-month contract under the ICMR-funded project "IIRP-2023-3274/F1" (SPLID Trial). The remuneration is Rs. 29,200 per month. Candidates need a Bachelor degree in computer applications/IT/computer science from a recognised university or institution. Applications must be sent by 13 November 2026, 5:00 PM, and the hard copy must reach the Pediatric office, GMCH, Chandigarh, by the same time.

how_to_apply: Send the application for the post of Data Entry Operator by 13 November 2026, 5:00 PM, with the documents attached in the mail. The notice does not print the email address to which the application goes.
After the online application, send the hard copy of the application with self-attested photocopies of certificates to: Pediatric office, Deptt. of Pediatrics, Block D, Level 4, GMCH, Chandigarh.
Make sure the hard copy reaches on or before 13 November 2026 up to 5:00 p.m. If it does not, the application will not be considered, even if the candidate applied online.
Age proof along with recent passport size photo

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is in the Department of Pediatrics of GMCH-32, Chandigarh, for an ICMR-funded clinical trial on the treatment of children with Dengue Shock Syndrome. The study, called the SPLID Trial, compares standard therapy with Plasmalyte in an open labelled randomised control trial. The Principal Investigator who signed the notice is Dr. Vidushi Mahajan (PI).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age: The notice prints "age-30 years" with the post name. It does not print a date on which age is counted. Age relaxation will be given as per ICMR/Govt rules to SC/ST/OBC categories on production of appropriate certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor degree in computer applications/IT/computer science from a recognised university or institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 29,200 per month (printed as "@29200/-per month"). The assignment is purely on contract basis for a period of three months. The appointment will be made from the staff strength sanctioned under the ICMR project. The appointment will not vest any right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption in GMCH 32/DHR/ICMR or continued contractual appointment. The contract will automatically expire on completion of three months, or earlier in case of withdrawal of support by the funding agency. The contractual appointment can be terminated at any time by either side by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCH Data Entry Operator
content_sections.text: Send the application for the post of Data Entry Operator by 13 November 2026, 5:00 PM, with the documents attached in the mail. The notice does not print the email address to which the application goes. Attach the documents listed below. After the online application, send the hard copy of the application with self-attested photocopies of certificates to: Pediatric office, Deptt. of Pediatrics, Block D, Level 4, GMCH, Chandigarh. Make sure the hard copy reaches on or before 13 November 2026 up to 5:00 p.m. If it does not, the application will not be considered, even if the candidate applied online. CV Age proof along with recent passport size photo Qualification Certificate(s) Experience Certificates Category certificate NOC from previous employer

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will initially be shortlisted based on the qualification and the work experience. If the number of candidates is more, a written test might be taken. The interview will be held in PIA Room, Block D, Level 2, Room no. 226, GMCH, Chandigarh. The notice does not mention the interview date. Bring the hard copies of all certificates mailed by yourself to the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The list of selected candidates shall also be displayed on the GMCH website.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the GMCH Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor degree in computer applications/IT/computer science from a recognised university or institution is required; work experience in project is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the GMCH Data Entry Operator post?

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the GMCH Data Entry Operator?
